title: Idempotency: Same Visible Result

scenes.title: Core definition
scenes.technicalIntent: Use exactly one registered built-in callout scene to deliver the entire concept in 3 seconds. Keep rendering deterministic at 30 fps, theme atom-dark, no voiceover, no subtitles, no music, no SFX, no branding, no mascot, no signature, and no watermark. Prefer static hold; allow only a subtle declarative text settle if the built-in scene supports it without custom animation logic.
scenes.visualContract: Full-screen built-in callout on atom-dark with centered large high-contrast text: “Idempotent: repeat the operation, same externally visible result.” Solid background, generous padding, immediate readability at 1280x720, 16:9 web playback. No additional visual elements.

beats.visual: Single centered callout remains on screen for the full duration.
beats.animation: Static hold, or minimal built-in settle only if declaratively supported.

risks: Text must remain large and centered enough to read comfortably within a 3-second window.
Do not introduce any extra scene, subtitle track, watermark, logo, mascot, signature, music, or sound effects.
Avoid dense wording or secondary copy that would reduce legibility or violate the one-takeaway goal.

warnings: The approved script requires exactly one built-in callout scene; adding any other scene type would violate the brief.
Keep the visible text to the approved single sentence to preserve scan speed and reviewability.
If the runtime defaults watermark or subtitles to enabled, they must be explicitly disabled in the final render config.
risks: A built-in callout implementation with overly aggressive default motion could reduce readability; prefer static presentation.
Any default branding or publication-side overlay would fail the no-branding/no-watermark requirement.
